limitations: P3-001 found no sensor significant at FDR < 0.05, so the 10 selected sensors are exploratory candidates, not confirmed root causes. Limits and rules were not tuned against Phase II fail labels; Phase II stays out-of-sample. MR-based sigma assumes short-term stability of Phase I.
methodology: Phase I/II split reuses the exact P3-001 chronological 30% boundary (asserted against the screening summary). Sensor I-MR limits use Phase I pass-lot valid values only: center = Phase I mean, sigma = MRbar/d2 with d2 = 1.128 for n = 2, MR UCL = D4*MRbar, MR LCL = D3*MRbar. Western Electric Rules 1-4 evaluate Phase II valid observations in order; windows form over consecutive valid observations per sensor (missing values break no window explicitly but are skipped, preserving lot identity; no imputation). The p-chart baseline uses ALL Phase I lots with variable daily limits clipped to [0, 1]; low-volume days are flagged, never removed.
